nodes.name: Theorem 1
Proposition 5.4
nodes.statement:
Let $\psi$ and $M(q,r)$ be as in as in Lemma 5.3, and consider $Y\geqslant X\geqslant1$ such that
\[
1\leqslant \sum_{X\leqslant q\leqslant Y} \frac{\psi(q)\varphi(q)}{q} \leqslant2 .
\]
For each $t\geqslant1$, set
\begin{equation} \begin{split} 
\mathcal{E}_t 
	= \big\{(v,w)\in (\mathbb{Z}\cap[X,Y])^2 :  \gcd(v,w)\geqslant  t^{-1}\cdot M(v,w) ,\ L_t(v,w)  \geqslant 10 \big\}.
 \end{split} \end{equation}
Then 
\[
\sum_{(v,w)\in \mathcal{E}_t}  \frac{\varphi(v)\psi(v)}{v}\cdot \frac{\varphi(w)\psi(w)}{w} \ll \frac{1}{t} .
\]

nodes.name: Proposition 6.3
nodes.statement:
Let $\psi:\mathbb{N}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}_{\geqslant 0}$, $t\geqslant1$ and $\mu$ be the measure $\mu(v)=\psi(v)\varphi(v)/v$. Let $\mathcal{V}\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $0<\mu(\mathcal{V})\ll 1$. Let  $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E},\emptyset,f_\emptyset,g_\emptyset)$ be a bipartite GCD graph with measure $\mu$, vertex sets $\mathcal{V}$, trivial set of primes, and edge set $\mathcal{E}\subseteq\mathcal{E}_t$, where $\mathcal{E}_t$ is defined as in Proposition 5.4. Then
	\[
	\mu(\mathcal{E})\ll 1/t.
	\]

nodes.name: Proposition 7.1
Proposition 8.1
nodes.statement:
Let $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$ such that 
\[
\mathcal{R}(G)\subseteq\{p>10^{2000}\}\quad\text{and}\quad \mathcal{R}^\flat(G)\neq\emptyset.
\] 
Then there is a GCD subgraph $G'$ of $G$ with edge density $\delta'>0$ and multiplicative data $(\mathcal{P}',f',g')$ such that
	\[
	\mathcal{P}\subsetneq\mathcal{P}'\subseteq\mathcal{P}\cup\mathcal{R}(G),
	\quad
	\mathcal{R}(G')\subsetneq \mathcal{R}(G),
	\quad 
	\min\bigg\{1,\frac{\delta'}{\delta}\bigg\} \cdot \frac{q(G')}{q(G)}\geqslant 2^N ,
	\]
	where $N=\#\{p\in\mathcal{P}'\setminus \mathcal{P}:f'(p)\neq g'(p)\}$.

nodes.name: Proposition 8.2
nodes.statement:
Let $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$ such that 
\[
\mathcal{R}(G)\subseteq\{p> 10^{2000}\},
\quad
\mathcal{R}^\flat(G)=\emptyset ,
\quad
\mathcal{R}^\sharp(G)\neq\emptyset.
\] 
Then there is a GCD subgraph $G'=(\mu,\mathcal{V}',\mathcal{W}',\mathcal{E}',\mathcal{P}',f',g')$ of $G$ such that
\[
	\mathcal{P}\subsetneq\mathcal{P}'\subseteq\mathcal{P}\cup\mathcal{R}(G),
\quad
\mathcal{R}(G')\subsetneq \mathcal{R}(G),
\quad 
q(G')\geqslant q(G).
\]

nodes.name: Proposition 8.3
nodes.statement:
Let $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\emptyset,f_\emptyset,g_\emptyset)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$ and trivial set of primes. Then there is a GCD subgraph $G'=(\mu,\mathcal{V}',\mathcal{W}',\mathcal{E}',\mathcal{P}',f',g')$ of $G$ with edge density $\delta'>0$ such that
\[
\mathcal{P}'\subseteq\{p\leqslant 10^{2000}\},
\quad
\mathcal{R}(G')\subseteq\{p> 10^{2000}\},
\quad
\min\bigg\{1,\frac{\delta'}{\delta}\bigg\} \cdot \frac{q(G')}{q(G)}\geqslant \frac{1}{10^{10^{3000}}} .
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 5.1
nodes.statement: Consider a function $\psi:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{R}_{\geqslant0}$ and let $\mathcal{A}$ be as in (1.3). Then either $\lambda(\mathcal{A})=0$ or $\lambda(\mathcal{A})=1$.

nodes.name: Lemma 5.2
Lemma 5.3
nodes.statement:
Consider a function $\psi:\mathbb{N}\to[0,1/2]$ and let $\mathcal{A}_q$ be as in (1.2). In addition, given $q,r\in\mathbb{N}$, set
\[
M(q,r):=\max\{r\psi(q),q\psi(r)\}.
\]
If $q\neq r$, then we have
\[
\frac{\lambda(\mathcal{A}_q\cap \mathcal{A}_r)}
{\lambda(\mathcal{A}_q)\lambda(\mathcal{A}_r)}
	\ll \mathds{1}_{M(q,r)\geqslant \gcd(q,r)} 
	\prod_{\substack{p|qr/\gcd(q,r)^2 \\ p>M(q,r)/\gcd(q,r)}} \left(1+\frac{1}{p}\right) .
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 7.3
nodes.statement:
For $x,t\geqslant1$ and $c\in[1,10]$, we have
	\[
	\#\bigg\{n\leqslant x: \sum_{\substack{p|n\\  p\geqslant t}}\frac{1}{p} \geqslant  c \bigg\} \ll x\exp\{ - t^{e^{c-1}}\}  \, ;
	\]
	the implied constant is absolute.

nodes.name: Lemma 7.2
nodes.statement:
Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and write $\tau_k$ for the $k$-th divisor function. If $f$ is a multiplicative function such that $0\leqslant f\leqslant \tau_k$, then
	\[
	\sum_{n\leqslant x} f(n) \ll_k x \cdot \exp\Big\{\sum_{p\leqslant x}\frac{f(p)-1}{p}\Big\} .
	\]

nodes.name: Lemma 10.1
nodes.statement:
Let	$G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$. For each $v\in\mathcal{V}$ and for each $w\in\mathcal{W}$, we let
\[
\Gamma_G(v):=\{w\in\mathcal{W}:\,(v,w)\in\mathcal{E}\}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\Gamma_G(w):=\{v\in\mathcal{V}:\,(v,w)\in\mathcal{E}\}
\]
be the sets of their neighbours. Then one of the following holds:
\begin{enumerate}
\item For all $v\in\mathcal{V}$ and for all $w\in\mathcal{W}$, we have
\[
\mu(\Gamma_G(v))\geqslant\frac{9\delta}{10}\mu(\mathcal{W})
\quad\text{and}\quad \mu(\Gamma_G(w))\geqslant\frac{9\delta}{10}\mu(\mathcal{V}).
\]
\item There is a GCD subgraph $G'=(\mu,\mathcal{V}',\mathcal{W}',\mathcal{E}',\mathcal{P},f,g)$ of $G$ with edge density $\delta'\geqslant \delta$, quality $q(G')\geqslant q(G)$, and such that either $\mathcal{V}'\subsetneq\mathcal{V}$ or $\mathcal{W}'\subsetneq \mathcal{W}$.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 8.4
nodes.statement:
Let $t\geqslant300$ and $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$ such that
	\[
	\mathcal{R}^\flat(G)=\emptyset,
	\quad 
	\delta\geqslant (10/t)^{50},
	\quad
	\mathcal{E}\subseteq\{(v,w)\in\mathcal{V}\times\mathcal{W}: L_t(v,w)\geqslant 10\}.
	\]
	Then there exists a GCD subgraph $G'=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E}',\mathcal{P},f,g)$ of $G$ such that
	\[
	q(G')\geqslant \frac{q(G)}{2}>0\quad\text{and}\quad
	\mathcal{E}'\subseteq \bigg\{(v,w)\in\mathcal{V}\times\mathcal{W}:
	\sum_{\substack{p|v w/\gcd(v,w)^2\\p\geqslant t,\ p\notin \mathcal{R}(G)}}\frac{1}{p}\geqslant 5\bigg\}.
	\]

nodes.name: Lemma 8.5
Lemma 12.2
nodes.statement:
Consider a GCD graph $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ with edge density $\delta>0$ and a prime $p\in\mathcal{R}(G)$ with $p>10^{40}$. Then one of the following holds:
\begin{enumerate}
\item There is a GCD subgraph $G'$ of $G$ with multiplicative data $(\mathcal{P}',f',g')$ and edge density $\delta'>0$ such that
\[
\mathcal{P}'=\mathcal{P}\cup\{p\},\quad
\mathcal{R}(G')\subseteq \mathcal{R}(G)\setminus\{p\},\quad 
\min\bigg\{1,\frac{\delta'}{\delta}\bigg\}
	\cdot \frac{q(G')}{q(G)} \geqslant 2^{\mathds{1}_{f'(p)\neq g'(p)}} .
\]
\item There is some $k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant0}$ such that
\[
\frac{\mu(\mathcal{V}_{p^k})}{\mu(\mathcal{V})}\geqslant1-\frac{10^{40}}{p}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\frac{\mu(\mathcal{W}_{p^k})}{\mu(\mathcal{W})}\geqslant 1-\frac{10^{40}}{p}.
\]
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 12.1
nodes.statement:
Consider a GCD graph $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ and a prime $p\in\mathcal{R}(G)$. 
For each $k,\ell\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant0}$, let
\[
\alpha_k=\frac{\mu(\mathcal{V}_{p^k})}{\mu(\mathcal{V})}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\beta_\ell=\frac{\mu(\mathcal{W}_{p^\ell})}{\mu(\mathcal{W})}.
\]
Then there exist $k,\ell\in \mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant0}$ such that $\alpha_k,\beta_\ell>0$ and
\[
\frac{\mu(\mathcal{E}_{p^k,p^\ell})}{\mu(\mathcal{E})} 	
	\geqslant 	
		\begin{cases}
		(\alpha_k\beta_k)^{9/10}
						&\text{if}\ k=\ell,\\
						\\
			\displaystyle\frac{\alpha_k(1-\beta_k)
				+\beta_k(1-\alpha_k)
				+\alpha_{\ell}(1-\beta_\ell)
				+\beta_\ell(1-\alpha_\ell)}{2^{|k-\ell|/20}\times 1000}
						&\text{otherwise}.
		\end{cases}
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 14.1
nodes.statement:
Consider a GCD graph $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ with edge density $\delta>0$ and let $p\in\mathcal{R}(G)$ be a prime with $p\geqslant 10^{2000}$. Then there is a GCD subgraph $G'$ of $G$ with set of primes $\mathcal{P}'=\mathcal{P}\cup\{p\}$ such that
\[
\mathcal{R}(G')\subseteq\mathcal{R}(G)\setminus\{p\}
\quad\text{and}\quad  q(G')\geqslant q(G)>0.
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 11.4
nodes.statement:
Let $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$. Let $p\in\mathcal{R}(G)$,  $r\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant 1}$ and $\ell\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant0}$ be such that $p^r>10^{2000}$ and
\[
\frac{\mu(\mathcal{V}_{p^\ell})}{\mu(\mathcal{V})}\geqslant 1-\frac{10^{40}}{p},
\]
and set $\mathcal{K}_{\ell,r}=\{k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant0}:|\ell-k|\geqslant r+1\}$. If $\delta_{p^k,p^\ell}$ denotes the edge density of the graph $G_{p^k,p^\ell}$, then one of the following holds:
\begin{enumerate}
\item There is $k\in\mathcal{K}_{\ell,r}$ such that $q(G_{p^k,p^\ell})>2q(G)$ and $\delta_{p^k,p^\ell}q(G_{p^k,p^\ell})>2\delta q(G)>0$.
\item $\sum_{k\in\mathcal{K}_{\ell,r}}  \mu(\mathcal{E}_{p^k,p^\ell})\leqslant\mu(\mathcal{E})/(4p^{31/30})$.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 11.6
Lemma 11.3
nodes.statement:
Let	$G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$. Let $p\in\mathcal{R}(G)$, $r\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant1}$ and $k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant 0}$ be such that $p^r>10^{2000}$ and
\[
\frac{\mu(\mathcal{W}_{p^k})}{\mu(\mathcal{W})}\geqslant 1-\frac{10^{40}}{p}.
\]
(In particular, if $p\leqslant 10^{40}$, the last hypothesis is vacuous.) 

If we set $\mathcal{L}_{k,r}=\{\ell\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant0}:|\ell-k|\geqslant r+1\}$ and write $\delta_{p^k,p^\ell}$ for the edge density of the graph $G_{p^k,p^\ell}$, then one of the following holds:
\begin{enumerate}
\item There is $\ell\in\mathcal{L}_{k,r}$ such that $q(G_{p^k,p^\ell})>2q(G)$ and $\delta_{p^k,p^\ell}q(G_{p^k,p^\ell})>2\delta q(G)>0$.
\item $\sum_{\ell\in\mathcal{L}_{k,r}}  \mu(\mathcal{E}_{p^k,p^\ell})\leqslant\mu(\mathcal{E})/(4p^{31/30})$.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 13.2
nodes.statement:
Let $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$. Let $p\in\mathcal{R}(G)$ be a prime with $p\leqslant 10^{2000}$.

Then there is a GCD subgraph $G'$ of $G$ with set of primes $\mathcal{P}'$ and edge density $\delta'>0$ such that 
\[
\mathcal{P}'=\mathcal{P}\cup\{p\},
\quad \mathcal{R}(G')\subseteq\mathcal{R}(G)\setminus\{p\},
\quad 
\min\bigg\{1,\frac{\delta'}{\delta}\bigg\}\cdot \frac{q(G')}{q(G)}\geqslant \frac{1}{10^{50}}.
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 11.2
nodes.statement:
Let $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ be a GCD graph with edge density $\delta>0$, and let $\mathcal{V}=\mathcal{V}_1\sqcup\dots \sqcup\mathcal{V}_I$ and $\mathcal{W}=\mathcal{W}_1\sqcup\dots \sqcup\mathcal{W}_J$ be partitions of $\mathcal{V}$ and $\mathcal{W}$. Then there is a GCD subgraph $G'=(\mu,\mathcal{V}',\mathcal{W}',\mathcal{E}',\mathcal{P},f,g)$ of $G$ with edge density $\delta'>0$ such that
\[
q(G')\geqslant \frac{q(G)}{(I J)^{10}},\qquad \delta'\geqslant\frac{\delta}{I J},
\]
and with $\mathcal{V}'\in\{\mathcal{V}_1,\dots,\mathcal{V}_I\}$, $\mathcal{W}'\in\{\mathcal{W}_1,\dots,\mathcal{W}_J\}$, and $\mathcal{E}'=\mathcal{E}\cap(\mathcal{V}'\times\mathcal{W}')$.

nodes.name: Lemma 13.1
nodes.statement:
Consider a GCD graph $G=(\mu,\mathcal{V},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{P},f,g)$ with edge density $\delta>0$, and let $p\in\mathcal{R}(G)$ be a prime. Then one of the following holds:
\begin{enumerate}
\item There is a GCD subgraph $G'$ of $G$ with multiplicative data $(\mathcal{P}',f',g')$ and edge density $\delta'>0$ such that
\[
\mathcal{P}'=\mathcal{P}\cup\{p\},\quad
\mathcal{R}(G')\subseteq\mathcal{R}(G)\setminus\{p\},\quad 
\min\bigg\{1,\frac{\delta'}{\delta}\bigg\}
	\cdot \frac{q(G')}{q(G)} \geqslant \frac{1}{10^{40}} .
\]
\item There is some $k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geqslant0}$ such that
\[
\frac{\mu(\mathcal{V}_{p^k})}{\mu(\mathcal{V})}\geqslant \frac{9}{10}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\frac{\mu(\mathcal{W}_{p^k})}{\mu(\mathcal{W})}\geqslant \frac{9}{10}.
\]
\end{enumerate}
